messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — RC cut is in ~36h. Please drop a slim release blurb into KEEP_CHANGELOG (or the shared Releases doc) by EOD tomorrow. I'm going to run the changelog-lint pass at 16:00 UTC and squash any format issues. If you expect a backport, add `backport:team` in the blurb so I can route it.
sam: Do we have a tiny example I can copy? Trying to avoid 5-line paragraphs :)
maria: Yep — keep it short: one sentence + optional single bullet. Include PR# and component tag. Example:

```
storage: compact shard metadata to reduce index size (#4123)
- avoids OOM during warmup; no behavior change
```

Use `component:` prefix if you want it shown (e.g., `component: runtime`).
jordan: Any hard length limit? Should we cap tokens or characters?
maria: Soft cap 140 chars for the sentence, bullets can be another 1-2 lines. Main thing: actionable phrase + PR# + scope tag. If it's a docs-only change, mark it `type:docs` so lint can skip the backport gating.
kevin: For 2.x backports — do we label the PR with `target/2.x` or open a separate backport PR? I've got #4290 that needs to land in 2.x too.
maria: Label `target/2.x` on the original PR and add the same blurb text to KEEP_CHANGELOG with `backport:kevin`. I'll coordinate the actual cherry-pick. If you prefer a separate PR, add reference to the original PR in the blurb.
release-bot: REMINDER scheduled: changelog-lint will run at 2026-03-18T16:00:00Z. Any format failures will post comments on PRs and ping @maria.
sam: thanks! I'll paste a 1-line blurb into the doc now.
maria: tiny PSA: avoid internal-only implementation details in the blurb — keep customer-facing language. If you need help trimming, drop the rough text here and I'll help condense. :sparkles:
kevin: Dropped my blurb and added `backport:kevin`. ping me if lint flags anything.
jordan: pasted mine too. left out the long rationale.
maria: perfect — appreciate the quick turns. I'll run the lint and post a summary after. If you get a lint comment, just fix formatting or tag me and I'll approve the doc change. :white_check_mark:
